name: Aditya Birla Cap
reason: Strong earnings shock (Qtr Profit Var 40.3 -> +3; Qtr Sales Var 27.4 -> +1) and high OPM (36.04) signal earnings acceleration and operating leverage. Promoter holding >65 supports stability of large moves. These catalysts can trigger momentum-driven 15%+ moves on breakout volume. News impact: recent Middle East conflict, rising oil and rupee weakness create negative market pressure (news adjustment applied, lowering confidence), but the firm-specific earnings/OPM catalyst still supports an asymmetric upside in a short, high-volatility window.

name: Bajaj Housing
